nom: medicube PDRN Pink Collagen Capsule Cream

avis.texte: While I did find this to be moisturizing and brightening, it is always so sticky! I have tried it on wet skin, dry skin, tried to use less, but every time it dries down sticky. Texture is big for me, so I wouldn't reconmend this.

avis.titre: Most promising product I have tried so far.
avis.texte: I have tried many products and so far this one has been the most promising, placing my second order today. My skin seems softer and my crows feet and smile lines seem to be diminishing, I am 59. The product is a bit sticky when first applied (the reason for 4 stars instead of 5, otherwise no complaints).
Love this! Gives a great glass skin effect and after a month of use I have 100% noticed my skin looks better, plumper and more even.

avis.titre: I don't think I would buy this again.
avis.texte: I have never used this product before. My skin was sticky after use. I have not had the stickiness with other products I have used in the past. I don't think I would buy this again.

This moisturizer is amazing. I would give it a 8.5/10. I've only been using it for 2 weeks, it is so far been very nice! Reminds me of the innisfree cherry blossom moisturizer. Leaves skin looking like glass. (Which is good).
I have been using this product of and on for about 8 months. It works great and if you're looking for a glowing skin, this is the perfect product…

I was recommended this product by my local Ulta employee. I have dry to normal skin and this was supposed to help me during the colder months. Unfortunately, this product gave me what it seemed was cystic, acne and tiny red dots all over my face it also made my skin more acne prone in areas that I normally do not get acne. I do not recommend this product. If you do want to try it I recommend you try it on a piece of skin that you feel safe to do so other than that, I do not recommend to anyone there are better products out there.
This new discover is a real game changer, light texture and super soft finish, with an incredible glass skin touch, I've never before had gotten this glow skin.
Really can tell a difference in my neck since using this product.
This was an absolyte miss for me, does not absorb into skin, feels sticky/tacky not sure about the hype on this product. Did return it.
Feels nice on the skin moisturizer as well. Wake up feeling Chloe.

This is my second time repurchasing this moisturizer. My skin loves it. I do two capsules and my skin looks plump and glowy. It's super soft the next day. I have an acne prone skin with an oily t-zone and dry cheeks and it's hydrating without leaving me too greasy. I'm surprised by the reviews because I only have good things to say about this moisturizer! I use it over niacinamide and retinol serum to help fade dark spots.

Very hydrating, perfect for dry winter months. It's the only moisturizer I've tried that can erase dry, flaky skin in one use. It creates a barrier over the skin, so make sure you cleanse well before applying. Try using a benzoyl peroxide wash beforehand to kill bacteria before putting it on your skin — otherwise you may breakout like some other people on here…

Super disappointed in this product. Does not absorb into skin. Rather makes your face sticky and pills after sitting on the face and drying down. An absolute waste of money. First Korean skincare product I've tried that is a swing and a miss.

I am a 60-year-old aesthetician. At first I thought this product could be. " gimmicky"' and was proven wrong. I find that if I use this product as the final step of my nighttime skin care routine, I wake up with absolutely beautiful glass skin. I've noticed that the fine lines around my eyes and across my forehead are slowly disappearing. As a final step to my nighttime routine, this product is allowed to absorb properly into my skin and do what it's supposed to do overnight. Absolutely love it. Purchasing my second jar.

This gave me the WORST breakout, along with the pink toner. And I am not usually prone to them. I am so upset because my skin looked so good. This product also burned my skin and ruined my skin barrier. BEWARE!
Does not absorb into skin as it says. It dried tacky and sticky. After 2 uses of the PDRN Pink capsule cream , I broke out , especially on my forehead. Melia all over the cheeks. Destroyed my skin.
I love this product. It took a couple months to see real results but its does work — however, notice it makes my skin a bit stick and causes tiny bumps on my face occasionally after usem
Love this product and it goes great under my makeup because its a bit tacky.
Fun for the novelty but I dont think I will use it all. Dries down sticky.

avis.titre: This is the best product for the price point!
avis.texte: This is the best moisturizer I have ever used! I tend to have oily skin but have dry patches and this takes care of both. My skin feels smooth and looks younger.
Smile lines disappeared in just 2 days of applying! Definitely, worth every penny. Korean skincare for the win
Texture of the cream is too sticky once applied and it was difficult to mix the capsules into the gel before applying to skin. It also caused some small pimples, which doesn't normally happen for me.

Like other comments say, it was confusing top understand at first and it was wayyy to clogging for my skin. Never usually have breakouts, saw a small burst occur with this product, only use it on my knees.
You gave to watch how you use it! Sure its hydrating but it definitely breaks you out and clogs your pores if you have dry, acne prone skin!!
Been using this for a week at night and the Vita C in the morning. My skin looks and feels so good! Great under makeup. My makeup looks good all day!
This product left my skin looking like glads but gave me HORRIBLE breakouts. Both cystic and tiny red pimples. My skin can handle almost any product… not sure what caused it.

avis.titre: I would buy it again and again
avis.texte: I really love it first time I got it and omg my skin feels so goooddd

avis.titre: Perfect weight, fun to use, great results
avis.texte: I'm loving this product so far! I'm in my late 40s and I live in the desert, so I'm serious about moisturizers. The weight of this product is perfect as an occlusive to sleep in. I apply a heavy layer before the pdrn pink wrapping mask like a lil pink bedtime princess, and wake up feeling like a glowing goddess. My skin has never been happier. Is the boba capauke kind gimmicky? Yeah. Do I love it anyway? Yeah. It's so pleasant to use. Will repurchase.
Love this product definitely worth the hype love the way it makes my skin feel and look
Product feels very smooth and hydrating on the skin. However, I'm using up the remaining product on my body because it's giving me cystic acne on my face. I have combo, slightly sensative skin

I bought it because of the boba look. Was fun to use but unfortunately I ran out of the pink boba way before the clear gel. Would not repurchase but not a terrible product and I am glad I tried it. The clear gel was just too sticky on it's own.
I really wanted to love this product, but it made me breakout. I will say it did give me a nice glow.
Love this product. I love it's consistently and how it's absorbed.

avis.titre: I will buy this product over and over again.
avis.texte: I love the refreshing feeling when I apply it. My face feels moisturized and has a glowing and bouncy feel. I have been using this product for about 4 months and I will keep on purchasing it.
Love the concept and i love medicube, but this is over hyped. It left my face very sticky and just didn't absorb well. 4/10

This product is amazing for my dry/combination skin. Plumping, soothing, moisturizing. My pores are smaller. It feels like putting a masque on because its heavy, but in a good way. I use powder foundation so the stickyness it leaves behind is actually like a primer. I love everything about this product!

I've been looking for moisturizer lately to help plump/hydrate my skin & prime my make up so it doesnt set into my forehead lines as much. After trying multiple moisturizers, this has been the only one that actually does my makeup look smoother, it helps lessen the setting of makeup into my fine lines.

I don't know if i might have a reaction to collagen in general, but this product gave me pimples, if i applied it in the morning then my skin would be RED and hot for the rest of the day. Made my pores irritated. Don't buy this and switch to COSRX or Mixsoon, this is not legit korean skincare

It has a plumping effect but it gave me a rash! I should return it- I love the texture even tho it's sticky and tacky, needs time to dry! Or just let it soak in- but I can use it it also made my forehead flaky
This product helped me so much. As someone who has severe dry skin, especially during winter; it helped me get hydration on my skin

I love this product! It has made my skin so soft! This is a night time cream! Do not use under make up! If you have dry skin or dark pigmentation this product is fo you! But get the entire line! I love oh soft my skin feels!!!

Im not sure about if i like this product or not. On my first days i started getting little pimples on my forehead and chin, no pus, and i dont know if its just purging or breaking me out. It might be irrelevant but the packaging is a very very cheap plastic that feels similar to bottle caps lol. The good thing is that when i apply the product it feels like collagen, very sticky, so i might keep using it for a month. But i dont have a lot of expectations

I have very dry skin. I've been using this 2 1/2 days my first day i used it at night and woke up to the softest skin ever. I use it with the medicube Pro Booster Age-R and i am BLOWN away. My deep forhead lines are barely noticeable and my skin looks amazing. I use it at night because its too too heavy and it never dries. It just eventually ends up on ur pillow.

avis.titre: Beautiful PM moisturizer but does not play well with makeup.
avis.texte: Ive been using this moisturizer with their milky toner and love the results for my skin, however I have found that this product causes any makeup to pill off. It is the worst with under eye concealer. I will not be repurchasing this product.

avis.titre: I was pleasantly surprised by how much I like this.
avis.texte: This product goes on smoothly, but needs time to dry a bit. My face does feel very moisturized even hours later.
Makes my skin so soft and moisturized Great product for older skin

Very hydrating product with no fragrance to it. Although i have combination oily/normal, I have dehydrated areas on my face and this product did the trick. I disagree with some people saying its too oily or greasy. The capsule is more oily and suited for dry areas (lack of sebum), while the gel part is more suitable for oily and dehydrated areas (lack of water in the skin). It might be too heavy for a face thats fully oily, but for combination, regular and dry is perfect. I only use it at night time cause for daytime or under makeup might be too much, although i would like to try the gel part during the day. Its nice to have the option to use the gel or the capsule cream or both. I have sensitive skin and so far it hasn't caused any irritation. Very solid moisturizer at an affordable price.
I use this product after i wash my face from a full day of wearing makeup! After applying this each night, this has changed my skin to look flawless! Highly recommend!!

I live in a pretty dry place, so maybe I have high expectations, but this really didn't feel very moisturizing to me. I would also say that this is definitely a nighttime product, otherwise it makes you look more greasy than dewy.

avis.titre: This product has been a GameChanger for my skin
avis.texte: I was so happy to see Ulta carry Medicube. I ordered this serum and the difference in my dry mature skin shocked me. Certain skin care products help but this one I noticed a difference pretty quickly

I have sensitive combination skin. I had such high hopes for this cream, but I was sadly disappointed. I tried every combination possible of pearls to gel and even time my face felt so sticky! Even overnight I woke up and it was still sticky. It also somehow felt dry and tight. it may be good for some people, but it's a no from me.

Was skeptical because anything with too much hype usually disappoints. But this changed my skin from the first usage. My skin has better bounce and the hydration is insane. Currently in the car on my way to pick up some of the other pieces from this line
I've tried so many different moisturizers that have either broke me out or made my oily skin worse. This moisturizer works so good with my skin and with my makeup products!
I break out easily and this stuff is amazing and a great price
